scope: Selected individually sourced records, not an exhaustive census.

events.title: Courtroom remark sparks controversy
events.summary: The Chief Justice's remarks during a hearing became a viral controversy. His subsequent clarification said his comments concerned people using bogus professional degrees, not young people as a whole.

events.title: First documented major Jantar Mantar mobilisation
events.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke arrived in Delhi; police granted permission for a demonstration about recruitment and examination irregularities.

events.title: Dipke assaulted at Jaipur demonstration
events.summary: Indian Express reported the founder was assaulted as he entered a protest and five suspects were arrested.

events.title: Parliament march meets barricades and police force
events.summary: Large crowds attempted to move toward Parliament. Police employed batons and tear gas; injuries and clashes were reported.

events.title: Police detail July march injuries and FIRs
events.summary: Police figures and allegations of property damage were reported; these do not independently resolve responsibility for each incident.

events.title: Education minister resigns; agitation withdrawn
events.summary: Dharmendra Pradhan resigned. CJP publicly announced an end to its agitation after government negotiations.

events.title: National Working Committee meeting announced
events.summary: CJP called its committee to review government commitments and possible renewed peaceful agitation. Meeting outcome not verified.

events.title: Electoral-roll campaign intensifies
events.summary: Reuters reported CJP demonstrations demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar resign over contested electoral-roll revisions.

events.title: Multiple groups join Delhi demonstrations
events.summary: Indian Express documented activists and political figures participating in demonstrations against the Election Commission.

events.title: Students travelling to Delhi detained
events.summary: At least 14 students travelling for the October 10 demonstration were detained, according to Indian Express reporting.

events.title: Leaders detained on arrival for Jantar Mantar demonstration
events.summary: Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were detained after landing in Delhi amid a policing operation.

events.title: Goa protesters detained
events.summary: Seven people were detained around Azad Maidan and later ordered released by the Goa bench of the Bombay High Court.

events.title: Jantar Mantar entry leads to fresh detentions
events.summary: Reported 14 movement members entered the restricted site and were detained. Police alleged advance scouting.

events.title: US-donor accusation and rebuttal
events.summary: Mary Millben alleged US funding, while Dipke challenged foreign interference in Indian politics. No transaction record included.

events.title: Joint public press conference
events.summary: CJP and AISA speakers appeared together and called for the October 16 flag-hoisting programme.

events.title: Lehra Do Tiranga rally and detentions
events.summary: Reuters reported police detentions at Connaught Place; accounts of attendance and legal justification differ.

events.title: Peaceful Pune rally reported
events.summary: Local organisers raised flags and renewed calls for civil rights, detainees' release and opposition to the SIR process.

events.title: Anti-SIR Town Hall gathering dispersed
events.summary: Indian Express reported roughly 50 activists detained after police cited a designated-site restriction.

events.title: Police describe FIRs and disputed protest videos
events.summary: Police reportedly registered cases involving prohibited gatherings and alleged fabricated clips; underlying media not forensically reviewed.

events.title: FIR reported over alleged communal slogans
events.summary: Indian Express reported an FIR against unidentified persons under BNS provisions; the alleged conduct is not adjudicated.
